newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka hits new high but market volume down.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka hits new high but market volume down.

text.p: Most Latvian shares maintained their recent steady rise on Tuesday with market leader Unibank making a near 15 percent gain to notch up a new year high of 2.01 lats, the Riga Stock Exchange said.

Overall market volume fell to 67,229 lats versus 165,000 lats last Thursday. Unibank's share price rose from 1.75 lats and more than 40,000 lats worth of its shares changed hands, the bourse said in a statement.
Riga Transport Fleet also closed up, with its share price jumping from 0.70 lats to 0.80 lats for a 14.29 percent rise. Volume in its shares was 20,480 lats.
Other shares were also active, with the Kaija fish cannery registering trade of 4,960 lats and its shares rising to 40 santimes from 35 santimes.
